> 非官方译本。数据源：`stablyai/orca` 的 GitHub Releases（跳过 mobile / android 与预发布）。已有中文底稿的版本不会被英文机翻覆盖。

## 完整中文日志 {#full-notes}

## v1.4.245 官方更新 {#v1-4-245}

2026年10月30日 发布 · [官方原文](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.245)

### A faster Orca, plugins & background computer use ⚡ {#v1-4-245-a-faster-orca-plugins-background-computer-use-}

- ⚡ **A faster Orca:** Launch smoothly with hundreds of chats, with less lag as you type and switch tabs.
- 🧩 **Customize Orca** with icon themes, syntax highlighting and custom editors.
- 🖱️ **Keep working** while agents use Chrome, Blender and other Mac apps in the background.
- 🌍 **Use the phone app in 11 languages**, with dictation that shows your words as you speak.

### Highlights {#v1-4-245-highlights}

- **A faster Orca:** Fast app with hundreds of chats. Typing stays more responsive, and hidden chats do less work while you use other tabs.
- **Plugins:** Add icon themes, syntax highlighting and custom editors from Settings → Plugins. Community publishing is coming soon, so you’ll be able to share your own plugins.
- **Background computer use on Mac:** Let agents work in Chrome, Blender and other apps while you keep using your mouse and keyboard. Orca’s in-app browser already works in the background; now computer use does too. Some actions still need the app brought forward.
- **Chats:** Send again after Stop and preview links in chat.
- **Terminals:** Set a running terminal limit for each computer in Settings → Terminal → Advanced.
- **WSL:** Stopped distros stay stopped until you choose Start. Terminals remember their folder.
- **Browser:** Press Cmd+Opt+B on Mac for a browser split. Send shorter annotation feedback, now with pasted images.
- **Workspaces:** Your workspace name becomes its branch name again. Source Control actions get Model and Effort controls.
- **Phone:** Choose from 11 languages, see dictation as you speak, and read clearer code, tables and diagrams.

### 兼容与升级说明 {#v1-4-245--}

- **New terminal host:** This release starts a fresh terminal host for new terminals. Terminals already open before the update keep running on the previous host and stay attached. The new running terminal limit setting needs the new host, and so do fixes such as the ble.sh startup fix and lighter process checks on macOS. Those apply to terminals you open after updating.
- **Plugins are on by default:** Installing a plugin, including from an `orca://plugins` link, only opens a review screen first. Plugins that run code ask for your consent before they install, and once approved they run with full access to your computer.
- **Running terminal limit:** The default now follows each computer: half of its system terminal limit, up to 4096, or 256 as before when Orca can’t read that limit. A value you set in Settings or with an environment variable takes priority. Raising or lowering it never closes running terminals. A remote server running an older Orca keeps working, but the limit can’t be changed there until it updates.
- **Chat naming:** Chats are now named by their own agent and account by default. A naming agent, custom command or arguments you saved before keep working, and the naming agent choice moved under Advanced in Settings → Chat → Chat naming.
- **Codex history across accounts:** A new switch, Settings → Agents → Share Codex history across accounts, is on by default and keeps today’s behavior. With it on, history from Orca’s managed accounts now also shows up in your own ~/.codex when you switch back to system default. Turning it off stops new sharing and removes nothing. On an SSH or WSL host running an older Orca, the switch stays disabled until that host updates.
- **Codex on macOS and Linux:** Orca now starts Codex with its paste guess turned off, so prompts typed from a phone or another client send instead of staying in the composer. Real pastes still arrive as pastes.
- **Computer use on a Mac:** Agents now act in the background by default. Agents can still ask for the old foreground mode with `--restore-window`, which drags into Chromium and Electron apps still need.
- **Browser annotations:** Send and Copy now give agents a short summary per note. Check **Include page details** in the Send menu to get the old full output; the choice lasts for that browser pane.
- **Workspace branch names:** A name you type for a new workspace is used as its branch again, even when Auto-rename branch from work is on. Auto-rename only replaces names Orca made up.
- **Automations:** Agents started by an automation skip their CLI’s startup update prompt, so the prompt can’t swallow the task. Agents you start yourself are unchanged.
- **Source Control actions:** Model and effort flags saved in an action’s Arguments move into the new Model and Effort controls when Orca loads; other Arguments stay as they are. A phone or remote server on an older Orca may launch these actions with a different model or effort until it updates.
- **New shortcuts:** Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+X opens Plugins (outside text fields), and Cmd+Opt+B on macOS opens a browser tab in a split to the right. Cmd+Opt+B can be changed in Settings → Keyboard.
- **Known limitation, downgrading:** If you go back to v1.4.244, custom model and effort choices on Source Control AI actions reset to the agent’s defaults, and updating again won’t bring them back.

> Mac apps driven in the background, Codex history you can keep apart per account, and steadier Grok, Antigravity and Mobile Emulator support.

- 允许：agents drive macOS apps in the background by default, without moving your pointer or taking your focus（[@AmoabaKelvin](https://github.com/AmoabaKelvin)，[#36005](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36005)）

- Start Codex on macOS and Linux without its paste guess, so prompts typed from remote clients send（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#35975](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35975)）

## v1.4.244 更多界面语言、更快切换工作区，远程文件像本地一样好用 {#v1-4-244}

2026年10月29日 发布 · [官方原文](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.244)

### 更快的 diff 与编辑器、更多语言，以及更好的远程文件 🌍 {#v1-4-244--diff-}

This release adds four interface languages, makes switching workspaces faster by preparing the one you’re about to open, and lets files on SSH hosts and paired servers play, save and open like local ones. It also brings smoother chat streaming, a faster prompt in new Windows terminals, steadier WSL terminals, and many fixes for dictation on the phone.

### 简要说明 {#v1-4-244-short}

- **四种新语言：** German, Russian, Turkish and Traditional Chinese join the language picker, and many more dialogs, menus and shortcuts are translated. German is machine-translated, and reviews from native speakers are welcome.
- **更快切换工作区：** Hovering a workspace in the sidebar gets it ready, the workspaces next to the current one stay warm, and the switch itself does less work. Dragging a row never switches.
- **远程文件像本地一样：** Play audio and video from SSH hosts and paired servers, save remote text files up to 50 MB, open folders too big for one reply as you scroll, and never open a remote binary as text.
- **更顺的聊天：** Long replies stream with less stutter, @file suggestions keep up in large repositories, and multi-agent Codex chats no longer grow the local chat history to gigabytes. Claude chats can rewind to before your first message.
- **更稳的终端：** New Windows terminals show their prompt right away instead of after about 3 seconds, closing or resizing a terminal no longer freezes the others on macOS and Linux, and WSL terminals keep their session and folder when their distro stops.
- **Browser:** Clear Google cookies from a profile when Google sign-in is stuck on an old account, import cookies from Vivaldi, and Orca no longer quits at startup on Windows and Linux when an extension’s helper window closes.
- **社区修复：** Kimi K3 for commit messages, Devin Desktop in Open In, highlighting for Glimmer, CUDA, Groovy and shebang scripts, `orca worktree create --branch`, `~` in the worktree location, MacPorts tools on macOS, and the faster Windows prompt.

**手机与网页更新：** Dictation on the phone keeps recording through a reconnect, keeps your words through calls and busy taps, gives your audio back when it stops, and explains setup before asking for the microphone. The mobile setup page now sends iPhone installs to the App Store. Korean 10-Key typing, held terminal keys, pairing and file saves on the phone work better, and the phone does less work in the background.

### 兼容与升级说明 {#v1-4-244--}

- **与 v1.4.243 相同的终端宿主：** This release keeps v1.4.243’s terminal host instead of starting a fresh one, so terminals open when you update keep running and stay attached. A few terminal fixes run inside the terminal host, such as the faster prompt in new Windows terminals, closing or resizing a terminal without freezing others, and Ctrl+C in Codex. They take effect once the terminal host restarts, for example after you restart your computer.
- **SSH 宿主与已配对服务器：** Some remote fixes need the host’s Orca server on this version too: saving large files, opening very large folders, theme answers for Codex in paired terminals, and copying from Codex started by hand (open a new remote shell after the host updates). Older servers keep their current behavior.
- **SSH 工作区：** Deleting a workspace on an SSH project now offers **Remove from Orca**, which leaves its files on the host untouched.
- **工作区切换：** Workspaces still switch on click. Holding the next or previous workspace shortcut (Cmd+Shift+Up/Down) now moves the sidebar highlight and switches once you let go.
- **Worktree 位置：** A location starting with `~` now means your home folder. A `~` value saved by an earlier version is expanded on the next start.
- **词分隔符：** Double-click always breaks words at spaces and tabs, even if your custom Word Separators setting leaves them out. The saved setting doesn’t change.
- **移动端安装：** The iOS button, QR code and copied link on the mobile setup page point to the App Store. The TestFlight preview option is gone; Android still uses the APK link.

---

#### Native chat (experimental) {#v1-4-244-native-chat-experimental-}

> Smoother streaming, chat history that stays small, and Claude rewind from the first message.

#### 测试、构建与维护 {#v1-4-244--}

> Groundwork for WSL hosts and for moving WSL projects onto them (internal, off in this build) and for plugins (off by default), CI moved to free hosted runners, more low-value tests removed, and continued Native Chat module organization.

#### All test, build and maintenance changes {#v1-4-244-all-test-build-and-maintenance-changes}

- 修复（wsl-host）：tell users how to fix a distro Orca can't host (D1c-1)（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#33085](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33085)）
- 新增（wsl-mover）：restore the host's browser link before a move, else say logins stay behind（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#33086](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33086)）
- 新增（wsl）：run Git for Windows for a WSL project on a Windows drive (D1c-2)（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#33090](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33090)）
- 性能（wsl-host）：a call made while the host connects joins that connect（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#33180](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33180)）
- 修复（wsl-move）：undo connects the WSL host after a relaunch, and startup heals a crash mid-pairing save（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#33279](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33279)）
- Land the WSL project mover dark (merges only after verify-15b, the flag-off audit and green CI)（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#34059](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34059)）
- 修复（wsl）：refuse Windows drive folders on a WSL host, offer Add on this computer（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#34530](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34530)）
- 新增（wsl）：internal distro allowlist that keeps WSL execs out of other distros on shared test boxes（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#34539](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34539)）

## v1.4.243 浏览器可装 Chrome 扩展，终端 Agent 会话可现场续到 Chat {#v1-4-243}

2026年10月28日 发布 · [官方原文](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.243)

### Orca 浏览器中的 Chrome 扩展、iPhone Duo 支持，以及终端 Agent 会话现场续到 Chat 🧩 {#v1-4-243-orca-chrome-iphone-duo-agent-chat-}

This release brings Chrome extensions to Orca’s browser under experimental, lets a conversation continue in Chat once you quit its agent in the terminal, and shows your local worktrees sooner after a restart. It also adds support for the folding iPhone Duo, compact native-style menus, light and dark themes on the phone, and fixes for Windows terminals, SSH hosts and updates.

### 简要说明 {#v1-4-243-short}

- **Chrome 扩展（实验性）：** Add extensions from the Chrome Web Store with **Add to Orca**, so password managers like Bitwarden and 1Password can fill logins in Orca’s browser. Off by default.
- **终端 Agent 会话现场续到 Chat：** Once you quit Claude or Codex in a terminal, the same conversation can continue in Chat while the terminal tab stays open. Claude chats also keep their saved approval choice across model changes, and closing a chat that’s still working asks first.
- **重启后更快看到 worktree：** Local worktrees load before terminals restore, and the sidebar says discovery is still running instead of showing an empty list.
- **更稳的终端：** Windows terminals keep their history through width changes, slept terminals wake in the folder you left, macOS’s built-in bash keeps command tracking in order after a DEBUG trap change, and copying from pi on a remote host reaches your clipboard.
- **Orchestration:** Choose the worker heartbeat interval or turn heartbeats off, and reduce CPU use by stopping settled workers from polling for commands.
- **关键处打磨：** Compact native-style menus, VS Code–style Markdown highlighting with sticky headings, and update checks through your Settings proxy.
- **社区修复：** Quit and Stop All Sessions, math in chats, Copy Remote URL with line ranges, IME highlighting in terminals, fnm on Windows, and Japanese and Chinese translations all work better.

**手机与网页更新：** Phones get light and dark themes, support for the folding iPhone Duo, PDFs in Quick Look and copy buttons in chats. Many phone screens now follow desktop’s rules for chats, Source Control and terminals, and typing and scrolling in long chats stay fast.

### 兼容与升级说明 {#v1-4-243--}

- **全新终端宿主：** New terminals start on a fresh terminal host so this release’s terminal fixes apply, including continuing a chat after its terminal agent exits. Terminals already open before you update keep running, and stay attached, on the previous host until you close them.
- **浏览器扩展（实验性）：** Turn on **Settings → Experimental → Browser extensions**, restart, then open the Chrome Web Store in an Orca browser tab. Extensions run in local browser profiles only. Ad blockers install but don’t block yet, and some extensions, such as Tampermonkey, don’t work.
- **Worker 心跳：** Heartbeats stay on every 5 minutes by default. Changes in **Settings → Agent Orchestration** apply to newly dispatched workers; workers already running keep their brief, and older hosts keep 5 minutes.
- **Claude 子 Agent 导航：** The eye that marked the subagent you’re viewing is gone. The viewed subagent row uses the normal current-row highlight.

---

- Start a worker in a new worktree from anywhere when you name the repo（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#34388](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34388)）
- Press Enter on a prompt Orca already pasted, even if the sending script disconnects（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#34373](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34373)）
- 停止：calling a worker’s prompt “submitted” when Orca couldn’t see the worker start（[@innocarpe](https://github.com/innocarpe)，[#21453](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21453)）
- Run typed setup commands without a subshell wrapper so zsh-autopair can’t corrupt them（[@mmarabel](https://github.com/mmarabel)，[#22537](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22537)）
- 保持：a record in each Run of what `orca orchestration reset --tasks` cleared（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#28823](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28823)）
- Target the calling terminal’s own workspace in folder projects from the CLI（[@AmoabaKelvin](https://github.com/AmoabaKelvin)，[#33703](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33703)）

#### 测试、构建与维护 {#v1-4-243--}

> Many low-value tests removed, CI jobs moved to free hosted runners, faster lint, continued Native Chat module organization, and groundwork for Slack and Discord connectors.

## v1.4.242 侧栏一点打开 Claude 子 Agent，Ask 模式先问再改，远程更记事 {#v1-4-242}

2026年10月27日 发布 · [官方原文](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.242)

### 更省内存、侧栏一点打开 Claude 子 Agent，以及更会记事的远程服务器 🪄 {#v1-4-242--claude-agent-}

This release is lighter on memory, with lower memory use in the terminal host and WSL connections, plus less idle CPU use in terminals. It also lets you open Claude subagents straight from the sidebar, makes Codex chats in Ask mode ask before editing, and helps paired servers, SSH and WSL hosts keep your tabs and explain failures. This release also fixes problems across Windows, Linux and macOS.

### 简要说明 {#v1-4-242-short}

- **侧栏打开 Claude 子 Agent：** Click a Claude subagent row in the sidebar or dashboard to open its transcript in the same terminal, then click the parent to go back. An eye marks the one you’re viewing.
- **聊天先问再改：** Codex chats in Ask mode now ask before editing your workspace, remote Claude terminals on paired servers can continue in Chat, and chats that can’t start tell you why.
- **Agent 按你离开时的状态恢复：** Resumed Claude sessions keep their effort level and launch flags, Codex keeps the permission you last gave it, and Session History finds chats in more folders and on servers.
- **远程服务器更记事：** Paired servers keep your tabs across restarts, closed tabs stay closed, WSL hosts stop re-pairing after each restart, and SSH failures say what actually went wrong.
- **更省内存：** Terminals use far less idle CPU, the terminal host uses less memory once it next restarts, WSL connections need much less memory, and the resource panel now matches Activity Monitor on macOS.
- **社区修复：** Spaced Windows launcher paths, Korean input, DST in automations, focus-follows-mouse, tab dragging and Linux packages all work better.

**手机与网页更新：** Phones now explain an unreachable computer instead of spinning forever, and streaming replies and long web chats redraw less. Terminal programs that ask the terminal a question also keep working while a phone watches at desktop size.

### 兼容与升级说明 {#v1-4-242--}

- **Ask 模式下的 Codex 聊天：** Ask now runs read-only and asks before workspace edits; Approve for me and Full access are unchanged, and work already running keeps its grant. Chats on a paired server keep the old behavior until that server is updated.
- **Claude 子 Agent 导航：** On by default with Claude status hooks. Orca loads its plugin only into Orca panes and adds one shortcut, the first free of Ctrl+Alt+G, H or V, to `keybindings.json` in each Claude folder it uses. Turn it off in Settings → Agents → Claude subagent navigation to remove that shortcut. Claude sessions already running need a fresh launch.
- **已配对服务器：** Moving a pane into a new tab and continuing a remote Claude terminal in Chat need the server to run this release. On older servers the move stays in this window only, as before, and Continue in Chat UI shows disabled with an update hint.
- **Claude 账户切换：** Switching accounts now also offers to restart sessions running in your System default Claude folder when that folder is signed in to the old account. The dialog groups sessions into those on the old account, others, and ones it can’t move.
- **WSL 宿主：** Connections to a WSL host’s server now go through bash and fall back to Node when bash is missing or too old. This needs no server update and works with any server version.

---

### 产品体验 {#v1-4-242-product}

#### Native chat (experimental) {#v1-4-242-native-chat-experimental-}

> Codex asks before editing, remote terminals continue in Chat, and chats that can’t start say why.

- Ask before Codex workspace edits in Ask mode, and apply permission changes to each fresh turn（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#31299](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31299)）
- Continue remote Claude terminal conversations in Chat on paired servers, from the pane or Session History（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#33954](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33954)）
- 发送：launch prompts and worker tasks through the retrying start so a first failed start doesn’t lose them（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#33832](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33832)）
- 显示：a start failure after one try when the agent’s answer can never succeed on a retry（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#33685](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33685)）
- Say why Claude refused to start a chat, including Full access while running as root（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#33812](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33812)）
- Make Stop pause Codex goal work, and start Set and Resume with the composer’s saved model and effort（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#33631](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33631)）
- 给予：a chat a fresh automatic name after /clear, while keeping names you set（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#32287](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32287)）

- 保持：a Pi chat open when Pi sends an event over 8 MiB, such as a large inline image（[@AmoabaKelvin](https://github.com/AmoabaKelvin)，[#33651](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33651)）

- List a chat once, under the app that wrote it, when Pi and OMP share a sessions folder（[@AmoabaKelvin](https://github.com/AmoabaKelvin)，[#33647](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33647)）
- Delete a server-hosted session on the server that owns it（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#33906](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33906)）
- 恢复：a server session whose workspace was deleted, and show previews for remote search hits（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#33965](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33965)）
- 发送：only an error code, not the raw message, when reporting a failed agent hook install（[@brynnclaw](https://github.com/brynnclaw)，[#25287](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25287)）

#### Orchestration & CLI {#v1-4-242-orchestration-cli}

- Find a worker’s coordinator from the caller, so starting a worker on another server works（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#33744](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33744)）

#### Terminals {#v1-4-242-terminals}

- Repaint Codex and Claude Code over the skipped-hidden-output notice（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#33835](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33835)）

- 保持：macOS `orca serve` out of the Dock, and let Linux servers opt in to the GPU（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#33878](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33878)）

## v1.4.241 聊天跟随 Agent 设置，内置浏览器更接近 Chrome {#v1-4-241}

2026年10月26日 发布 · [官方原文](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.241)

### 聊天与浏览器按你预期工作 🧭 {#v1-4-241--}

This release makes chats follow your agent settings, brings Chrome-style tools to the built-in browser, and helps SSH connections and managed servers recover. You’ll also find a chat font setting, live agent browsing, and steadier Hermes, Kimi, Kiro and Windows terminals.

### 简要说明 {#v1-4-241-short}

- **聊天跟随你的设置：** New chats use each agent’s permission from Settings → Agents, renamed chats keep their names in Session History, and a chat won’t write a conversation a terminal is still running.
- **浏览器更接近 Chrome：** Dock DevTools inside the pane, mute tabs playing sound, see a link’s URL on hover, and use Orca shortcuts and mouse back/forward inside pages.
- **看着 Agent 浏览：** A cursor and badge show where an agent is clicking or typing, chat jumps you to the page, and links from terminals and chat open beside their source.
- **SSH 更少死胡同：** Saved port forwards return after a restart and explain failures, certificate-only hosts connect through your system `ssh`, and managed servers update without closing terminals.
- **Agent 启动与恢复更可靠：** Hermes and Kimi panes resume after a restart, Kiro reports status on its V3 engine, and keys typed while an agent starts are kept as a draft.
- **关键处打磨：** Pick a font for chat, zoom with Cmd/Ctrl + `+` on non-US keyboards, open cloud-only files from macOS terminals, and get steadier Windows terminals and pasting.

**手机与网页更新：** Phones no longer drop pieces of terminal output, and chat renames and each chat’s permission mode now show there. Session tabs also keep Working and Needs You for Windows agents that never set a title.

### 兼容与升级说明 {#v1-4-241--}

- **全新终端宿主：** New terminals start on a fresh terminal host so this release’s terminal fixes apply. Terminals already open before you update keep running, and stay attached, on the previous host until you close them.
- **聊天权限：** Settings → Chat no longer has its own permission dropdown; set it per agent in Settings → Agents. Existing chats keep their saved permission, and a chat’s own permission menu changes only that chat.
- **在终端中打开的对话：** If a terminal might still be writing a conversation, its chat won’t send and asks you to quit the agent there or close that terminal. Closing that terminal lets the next send go through.
- **托管 SSH 服务器：** **Update anyway** keeps running terminals going through the update. The offer to resume chats after a restart needs a server already running this release.
- **OpenCode 模型选择：** OpenCode 2.0.14, 2.0.15, 2.0.17 and 2.0.18 leave the first message unsent when a model is picked, so Orca refuses model picks on those versions.

---

#### Native chat (experimental) {#v1-4-241-native-chat-experimental-}

- Never start a chat’s agent on a conversation a terminal is still writing, and keep restored panes from resuming a conversation an open chat holds（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#30930](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30930)）

## v1.4.240 对话跟着你走，浏览器有可搜索历史，远程更少打断 {#v1-4-240}

2026年10月25日 发布 · [官方原文](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.240)

### 更可靠的工作区 🐳 {#v1-4-240-a-more-dependable-workspace-}

本版本为内置浏览器带来可搜索历史，让 Agent 活动更易跟随，并改进聊天与远程终端的恢复。还有 Lean 与 Zig 语法高亮、更大的快捷命令集合，以及用于查找开发服务器的新命令 `orca ports`。

### 简要说明 {#v1-4-240-short}

- **对话跟着你走：** Claude 聊天显示在 Orca 外完成的回合；保留的消息重连后无需重开聊天即可回来；崩溃恢复不再误判已发送消息未送达。
- **浏览器记性更好：** 可搜索浏览历史、重开页面、去掉不想要的建议，并用撤销清空历史；页面也可通过 File System Access 使用你挑选、保存或拖入的文件。
- **远程工作更少打断：** 慢连接能挺过漏掉的唤醒探测，重连提示会说明发生了什么，SSH 终端会等你登录，新分屏留在已配对服务器上。
- **可信的 Agent 状态：** 已完成的 Codex 子 Agent 不再显示为 Working；主任务在 `/side` 对话期间仍可见；需要审批的 Codex MCP 工具会弹出审批卡片。
- **给工作流更多空间：** 可保存超过 40 条快捷命令；用 `orca ports` 查找 worktree 检测到的开发服务器端口；从开发 worktree 回收旧依赖安装与构建产物。
- **关键处打磨：** Lean 与 Zig 高亮、更清晰的会话搜索摘录、Mac 触控板在终端应用中滚动更顺，以及对未合并分支与 Windows/WSL 共享 worktree 的更好保护。

**手机与网页更新：** 更新为手机或浏览器提供服务的那台电脑上的 Orca，也会更新被提供的界面。本版本还让配对与移动视图在 `/side` 对话期间保持可见正在运行的 Codex 任务，并修复浏览器挑选或拖入的聊天附件上传到已配对服务器。

### 兼容与升级说明 {#v1-4-240-compatibility-upgrade-notes}

- **实验性 Native Chat：** 请与 Orca 一并更新已配对与 SSH 宿主，以获得最新的聊天、Agent 状态与启动修复。Codex 的新审批卡片覆盖不需要表单字段的 MCP 工具审批；通用 MCP 表单与基于 URL 的验证不在本次变更范围内。
- **浏览器历史：** 从页面菜单打开 **History**，或使用 macOS 上的 **Cmd+Y**、Linux/Windows 上的 **Ctrl+H**。可搜索、删除单条，或清空最近一小时 / 今天 / 全部，清空支持撤销。
- **检测到的端口：** `orca ports` 在支持宿主范围端口扫描的运行时上支持工作区选择与 JSON 输出。直连 SSH 宿主尚不支持检测；原生文件夹工作区需 `--all` 才能列出宿主上的监听端口。
- **开发清理：** 手动 `pnpm reclaim-space` 与开发启动时的自动清理，可回收旧兄弟 worktree 中被忽略、未跟踪的依赖安装与生成产物，默认 30 天截止。选中的、正在调用的与排除的 worktree 受保护。手动清理前请停止兄弟应用、Agent、安装、构建与测试；被回收的安装与产物再次使用时需重装或重建。
- **终端文件链接：** 先前「在点击处所在工作区打开文件链接」的改动已在本版本撤回。

> 保持：project actions on the right host, protect branches and worktrees, and let cold WSL distributions finish starting.

- 避免：synchronous WSL home-directory probes at startup and premature termination of a booting distro（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#33179](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33179)）

## v1.4.239 - Skills, ready wherever you… {#v1-4-239}

2026年10月24日 发布 · [官方原文](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.239)

**Two releases today!** Check out the [v1.4.238 release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.238) too. That release brought shared unsaved edits across workspaces, richer agent chats and remote account setup, a more capable browser, and smoother phone controls.

### Your workspace, working together 🐳 {#v1-4-239-your-workspace-working-together-}

Set up agent skills in one click, keep browser sessions separate between projects, and move more easily between chat and terminal. This release also strengthens the essentials: shared files stay in sync, SSH sessions recover more reliably, and phone interactions feel more predictable.

### 简要说明 {#v1-4-239-short}

- **Skills, ready wherever you work:** Install Orca’s skills in one click from setup screens, and install or update them on paired servers and SSH hosts with Orca’s own installer.
- **A browser that fits your projects:** Choose shared, per-repo or per-workspace profiles for new tabs. Keep local app logins separate, use a familiar page context menu, and get clearer explanations when a page cannot load.
- **More fluid agent conversations:** Split into a fresh chat beside your current one, continue with a terminal agent from the pane header, and keep queued messages and multiple 图片附件 intact.
- **Safer edits, quieter background work:** Shared file views stay current after undo and discard. Non-UTF-8 files ask before conversion, file watching recovers after slowdowns, and Orca watches fewer unrelated files.
- **Remote work with a way back:** Recover supported managed SSH servers from a stale lock in Settings, restore terminals after password sign-in, and keep a paired server’s SSH access link through restarts.
- **Better from your phone:** Tapping a notification opens the agent that sent it, agent chat tabs can start dictation, terminal copy commands reach the phone clipboard, and Android scrolling keeps the keyboard out of the way.
- **Everyday polish, across languages:** Better Korean input, Bengali and other Indic terminal rendering, more complete translations, Jira user pickers, and PR comment links that jump straight to the editor.

**手机更新：** Updating Orca on the computer serving your phone updates the served interface. Native download, progress and navigation improvements require an updated native phone app.

### Compatibility & upgrade notes {#v1-4-239-compatibility-upgrade-notes}

- **Browser profiles:** Choose **Settings → Browser → Profile for new tabs**. **Shared** remains the default; per-repo and per-workspace profiles apply to new tabs. Paired-server pages use the server’s own profiles.
- **实验性 Native Chat：** Update paired and SSH hosts alongside Orca for the latest chat and launch fixes. Chat availability now checks the chat runtime separately from the terminal CLI, including supported Antigravity setups.
- **SSH recovery:** **Recover server…** is available for supported managed Linux SSH hosts reporting a stale-lock refusal. It checks the lock and asks you to confirm that no other machine sharing that home is running Orca before clearing it. Phones point you to desktop Settings.
- **Experimental groundwork:** Connector work remains behind the off-by-default `experimentalConnectors` flag. The layout-owner groundwork remains disabled. The empty-group launch actions and child-workspace status toggle were reverted before release.

---

## v1.4.238 - Your edits stay together: … {#v1-4-238}

2026年10月23日 发布 · [官方原文](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.238)

### More connected work, safer edits 🐳 {#v1-4-238-more-connected-work-safer-edits-}

This release makes it easier to move between agents, files, browsers and remote machines. Tabs of the same file now share unsaved edits, Native Chats pick up turns made elsewhere, and the phone gets more dependable terminal gestures and richer tab controls.

### 简要说明 {#v1-4-238-short}

- **Your edits stay together:** Tabs of the same file share unsaved text across workspaces. Conflict review sees that live text, workspace deletion lists unsaved files, and stale Markdown or notebook edits no longer overwrite newer work.
- **Chats that keep up:** Codex and Pi show turns made outside the chat. Long pastes can become text attachments, Codex questions get answer cards, and OMP gains image sending and actionable plan-review cards.
- **More control over agents:** Pick chat or terminal when creating a workspace, set that choice for your default agent, add Claude and Codex accounts on supported remote servers, and install shared skills for 11 more agents.
- **A more capable browser:** A workspace-aware new tab, address-bar suggestions, remembered site permissions, per-site appearance and zoom, and page-loading progress on desktop and phone.
- **A smoother phone experience:** See agent activity in tabs, rename with a double-tap, scroll back through earlier chat messages, select terminal text more naturally, and return to your terminal reading position after resuming.
- **Better visibility and recovery:** Inspect local terminals in Resource Manager, use plain SSH when a host’s move to an Orca server is blocked, and keep pairings through managed-server updates and recovery.
- **Everyday polish:** Brazilian Portuguese, language selection during onboarding, searchable release builds, clearer history-scan progress, and **Resolve with AI** for paused merges, rebases and cherry-picks—even after file conflicts are fixed.

**手机更新：** Updating Orca on the computer serving your phone updates the served interface. The new **Home → New Workspace** entry and native iOS dictation fixes require an updated native phone app; the home-screen entry ships with the next app build.

### Compatibility & upgrade notes {#v1-4-238-compatibility-upgrade-notes}

- **Remote accounts:** Update the paired server for the new Claude and Codex Add Account flow. Windows servers and older hosts retain the `orca account add` guidance. Credentials stay on the server; remote re-authentication of an existing account is outside this change.
- **实验性 Native Chat：** Update paired and SSH hosts alongside Orca for the latest chat fixes. Agent version checks now accept newer releases and prereleases that meet the required minimum; a known older version shows update guidance.
- **Resource Manager:** The new PTYs view covers local terminals. Ending a terminal requires host support for verifying the selected session; older hosts refuse unchecked termination.
- **HTML files:** Opening HTML in preview by default was reverted for this release.
- **Experimental groundwork:** Layout-owner and sidebar changes listed below remain disabled. Connector configuration is off by default, and the new optional agent-write controls have no existing callers enabled.

---

## v1.4.237 手机端能做的更多：笔记、无头 Markdown，以及更稳的聊天与远程 {#v1-4-237}

2026年10月21日 发布 · [官方原文](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.237)

### 十万星标，感谢！⭐🐳 {#v1-4-237--}

Orca 刚刚突破 GitHub **100,000 star**！每一份 bug 报告、pull request、共享工作流与推荐都帮我们走到这里。感谢与我们一起用 Orca 构建，并塑造接下来的方向。❤️

为表庆祝，本版带来更强的手机体验、更可靠的 Agent 对话，以及让工作在桌面与远程机器间持续推进的修复。

### 简要说明 {#v1-4-237-short}

- **手机端能做的更多：** 创建和编辑笔记，在无头宿主上保存 Markdown，跟随相对文件链接，并查看内嵌图片。缓冲的终端草稿在切换工作区后也能保留。
- **聊完还能回来：** Codex 聊天在撤销后能正确重开，Claude 在 Orca 回滚后仍保留已 Rewind 的上下文，截图会跟着对话走。Codex 技能选择器现在反映 Codex 实际加载的技能。
- **工作更受保护：** Discard 会暂停跨工作区对同一文件的自动保存。只读 Markdown / CSV 视图保护未保存编辑；新建、未暂存的 Markdown 会直接进入富文本编辑器。
- **桌面之外的语音：** 通过无头 `orca serve` 宿主，手机听写再次可用，并可用 CLI 配置宿主的 OpenAI key。
- **更顺的远程工作：** 重启后重连隐藏的终端标签，宿主再次配对时保留浏览器登录，在有数千台主机的 SSH 配置里搜索而不卡死界面。
- **小细节，更顺手：** 手机标签跟随桌面顺序，横屏布局显示会话标题，键盘控件保持高度，worktree 安全扫描会跳过未改动的工作区。

**手机更新：** 更新为手机提供服务的那台电脑上的 Orca，也会更新手机端被提供的界面。持久终端草稿还需要更新过的 mobile shell。

### Compatibility & upgrade notes {#v1-4-237-compatibility-upgrade-notes}

- **实验性 Native Chat：** Update paired and SSH hosts alongside Orca to get the latest chat fixes. Exact Codex skill-file selection is available on desktop with a supporting host; phone selections and older hosts retain plain-text skill names. Send a skill as a new message for Codex to apply it at the start of a turn.
- **无头听写：** Save the OpenAI key on the host doing the transcription with `orca speech openai-key set` (reads the key from stdin). Installed-app `orca serve` hosts on Linux and macOS can also use the bundled on-device recognizer; Windows, managed SSH and WSL servers use cloud models.
- **CLI 启动选择：** Explicit `--surface` choices require an updated execution host. Omitting the option keeps your existing defaults.

---

### 产品体验 {#v1-4-237-product}

#### Native chat (experimental) {#v1-4-237-native-chat-experimental-}

> 挑选 Codex 实际加载的技能，自信地回到对话，并完整保留聊天历史与附件。

- 在聊天中使用 Codex 自己已加载的技能目录；桌面选择会定位到确切的技能文件，即使名称重复也能区分（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#30937](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30937)）
- 撤销后重开 Codex 聊天，并以正确的对话历史继续（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#31041](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31041)）
- 即使回滚 Orca，仍保持 Claude 已 Rewind 的上下文完整（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#31231](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31231)）
- 在 Claude 实际收到的位置显示回合中途发送的 prompt 与 `!` 命令（[@AmoabaKelvin](https://github.com/AmoabaKelvin)，[#31204](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31204)）
- 拖入聊天的截图在该聊天生命周期内保持可用（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#30419](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30419)）
- 重试失败的聊天命名，在标签悬停卡片上显示命名错误，并提供 **Regenerate name**（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#30646](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30646)）
- 设置更新后，已恢复的 Claude 聊天仍可立即接收消息（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#30982](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30982)）
- 仅在 Claude、Pi 或 ACP 处理工作时显示 **Working**，同时保持 Claude 聊天 worker 运行（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#30577](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30577)）
- 将休眠的 Native Chat 工作区显示为休眠，并在侧栏筛选要求时隐藏它们（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#28457](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28457)）
- 将完成通知关联到正确的 hook 驱动回合（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#30620](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30620)）
- 澄清如何在聊天与终端 Agent 之间继续对话（[@AmethystLiang](https://github.com/AmethystLiang)，[#31402](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31402)）

#### 手机端 {#v1-4-237--}

> 在工作区之间切换而不丢失草稿，无需打开桌面窗口即可处理 Markdown，界面也更一致。

## v1.4.235 Claude 聊天可 Rewind 到任意一轮，每段对话记住自己的模型设置 {#v1-4-235}

2026年10月20日 发布 · [官方原文](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.235)

感谢使用 Orca，也感谢一直以来的支持。

This release makes conversations easier to revisit, keeps more of your agent's work, and cuts background editor activity when you're juggling workspaces.

### 简要说明 {#v1-4-235-short}

- **Rewind Claude chats:** Use **Rewind to here** on a message that started a turn, edit your prompt, and take the conversation in a new direction. Claude continues from the history you kept.
- **Your chat, your settings:** Each conversation remembers its own model, effort and Fast settings. Switching models keeps compatible choices, and changes to an agent's defaults no longer silently move a chat that has recorded its settings.
- **Keep more of your agent's work:** Completed replies and tool results are saved in full rather than cut off at the preview limit. Use **Show full output** on desktop or phone, or **Show full message** on phone, to load more content from shortened previews.
- **Less waiting, less background work:** New Chat opens the composer immediately, Codex chats get the time they need to start, and the workspace jump palette is preloaded. The editor watches active, recent and at-risk workspaces instead of every workspace with an open tab.
- **A better phone experience:** Live chats reconnect from where they left off, project groups stay in step with desktop, and ready cloud dictation models can be selected from the phone. Workspace creation starts preparing the checkout while you fill in the form.
- **Everyday polish:** Edit images in queued desktop messages, see machine labels only when project names collide, and get more reliable workspace lists, file-conflict handling and remote workflows.

**手机更新：** Updating Orca on your desktop also updates the app on your connected phone—the phone loads it directly from your desktop.

### Compatibility & upgrade notes {#v1-4-235-compatibility-upgrade-notes}

**实验性 Native Chat：** Keep paired and SSH hosts updated alongside Orca for the latest chat features. Full-content loading requires host support; content discarded by older versions cannot be recovered. Very large items may still be shortened for display or delivery.

**Cloud dictation:** Select a ready cloud model from the phone's dictation setup or **Settings → Voice**. Configure its API key on the computer serving the phone first.

---

### 产品体验 {#v1-4-235-product}

#### Native chat (experimental) {#v1-4-235-native-chat-experimental-}

> Revisit Claude conversations, keep each chat’s settings consistent, and work with images and long outputs more comfortably.

- Rewind Claude chats from messages that started a turn, continuing with the conversation you kept（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#30400](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30400)）
- Remember model, effort, speed and Fast choices per conversation, including across restarts（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#30561](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30561)）
- Save completed replies and tool results in full, with controls to load more from shortened previews（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#29982](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29982)）
- Edit images in queued desktop messages: remove, paste, drop or attach（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#30815](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30815)）
- 打开：the New Chat composer immediately while the host gets ready（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#29358](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29358)）

## v1.4.233 SSH 与远程工作区：无下载也能连通，Settings 里远程服务器更清晰 {#v1-4-233}

2026年10月20日 发布 · [官方原文](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.233)

感谢使用 Orca，也感谢一直以来的支持。

We shipped two releases today! If you missed it, check out the [v1.4.232 release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.232) too. Highlights include Manual / Auto / Yolo agent permissions, OpenCode 2 in Native Chat, a better phone composer with file attachments and inline skills, smoother SSH recovery, and a smaller app with faster Mac updates.

**手机更新：** Updating Orca on your desktop also updates the app on your connected phone—the phone loads it directly from your desktop.

### 简要说明 {#v1-4-233-short}

- **SSH & remote workspaces:** Connecting to an SSH host works when neither machine can download Node.js, with a one-click mirror Orca remembers and retries. Older Windows hosts (Windows 10 1809 and Server 2019) can run Orca's server, and tunnels recover when a port is held by an old SSH connection.
- **Remote servers in Settings:** Remote Orca Servers is one list instead of six sections, and SSH hosts can be removed in bulk and stay removed. Orca tells you when the same server was saved twice, and adding a server you already saved updates it instead.
- **Phone:** Creating a workspace from the phone is much faster, the workspace list stays in step with the desktop, and session tab icons keep their size beside long titles.
- **Editor:** Orca refuses to save over changes made to a file on disk that you haven't seen, and Reload and Undo behave predictably afterwards.
- **Everyday polish:** Projects with the same name on different machines keep short names and show which machine they're on. Long saved conversations use far less memory when Orca scans them for Session History.

---

### 产品体验 {#v1-4-233-product}

#### SSH, managed servers & remote {#v1-4-233-ssh-managed-servers-remote}

- A legacy relay restarted at the same socket never takes over an open tab（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#31068](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31068)）

## v1.4.232 自动权限进聊天与终端，Native Chat 支持 OpenCode 2 与 $ 技能 {#v1-4-232}

2026年10月20日 发布 · [官方原文](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.232)

感谢使用 Orca，也感谢一直以来的支持。

### 简要说明 {#v1-4-232-short}

- **Auto permissions, in chat and terminal:** Choose **Manual | Auto | Yolo** in Settings → Agents. Auto lets supported Claude and Codex agents handle approvals, and new Native Chats follow your choice too. You can choose a separate permission mode for other agents; existing chats keep their own settings.
- **实验性 Native Chat：** Open OpenCode 2 directly in chat, find Codex skills by typing `$`, and pan and zoom image previews. Rewind works in long conversations, and usage limits show when they reset with a **Continue** button to pick the conversation back up.
- **A better phone composer:** Attach files as well as photos, insert skills inline, and choose model, effort and permissions from one sheet. Faster recovery after switching apps and more responsive terminal scrolling make it easier to keep working away from your desk.
- **Smoother SSH work:** Managed servers recover from lost pairing over SSH, tunnels follow a restarted server's port, and unsaved editor drafts survive the move to a managed server. File uploads work better over high-latency links, and a configurable Node.js mirror helps on networks that block nodejs.org.
- **More control over your workspace:** Space responds faster, lets you inspect changed files before cleanup, and puts row actions in a dedicated menu. Browser pages can ask for a username and password, and Orca asks before a page opens another app.
- **A lighter app and faster Mac updates:** Shared desktop and browser assets, fewer duplicate resources and smaller tour animations reduce the app's footprint. macOS updates avoid background installer throttling, helping Orca get back to your work sooner.

### Compatibility & upgrade notes {#v1-4-232-compatibility-upgrade-notes}

**实验性 Native Chat：** Some chat features require support from the remote host. Keep paired and SSH hosts updated alongside Orca to use the latest capabilities.

**Auto permissions:** Availability depends on the agent, model and host version. Changing the default applies to new sessions; existing Native Chats retain their saved permissions.

---

### 产品体验 {#v1-4-232-product}

#### Native chat (experimental) {#v1-4-232-native-chat-experimental-}

> OpenCode 2 opens in chat, Codex and Pi skills are easier to find, image previews support pan and zoom, and long conversations are easier to resume and rewind. Usage limits explain the pause and offer Continue, while sent images and visuals stay with the chat.

#### SSH, managed servers & remote workspaces {#v1-4-232-ssh-managed-servers-remote-workspaces}

> Reconnect and re-pair more reliably, keep tab closes through reloads, preserve unsaved editor drafts during migration, and upload files faster over high-latency links. Setup handles more hosts and restricted networks, with clearer disk-space, download and connection errors.

- 修复（renderer）：restored SSH session placeholders carry the host a listing would stamp（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#30445](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30445)）
- 修复（open-in）：open a managed server's workspace in VS Code over Remote-SSH（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#30441](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30441)）
- 修复（terminal）：reattach a restored terminal while an older daemon cannot answer (#30486)（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#30499](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30499)）
- 修复（ssh）：rehome a cold-start converted workspace the scan missed, and notify replayed background-turn completions（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#30578](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30578)）
- 修复（ssh）：follow a relaunched managed server's port; match quoted Windows forward argv（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#30583](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30583)）
- 修复（terminal）：relay-era SSH panes open printed file paths on the host's server（[@OrcaWin](https://github.com/OrcaWin)，[#30240](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30240)）
- 修复（ssh）：managed servers install through SSH gateways that cut long commands (#30491)（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#30549](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30549)）
- 修复（ssh）：relinking a stopped managed server keeps the project groups it holds, and later moves don't re-send them（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#30608](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30608)）
- 修复（ssh）：make room for the pre-activation snapshot on remote hosts, and say why a capture failed（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#30618](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30618)）
- 修复（ssh）：a cancelled or revoked host's browser command stops on the desktop（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#30630](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30630)）
- 修复（ssh）：closing a bridged relay tab stops its shell, even across a restart（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#30587](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30587)）
- 修复（ssh）：keep SFTP uploads pipelined so a high-latency link doesn't crawl（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#30704](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30704)）
- 修复（ssh）：say the host's disk is full when a managed-server install runs out of space（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#30679](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30679)）
- 修复（ssh）：say a noexec home can't run Orca's server, instead of "install an older version"（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#30724](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30724)）
- 修复（remote）：keep a paired host's undelivered tab close across a reload（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#30758](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30758)）
- 修复（ssh）：a network cut during a managed-server install no longer hangs, and says contact was lost（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#30732](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30732)）

- 修复（orcad-migration）：a pane saved in two tabs refuses on this desktop and names the tabs, not a server conflict（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#30801](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30801)）

## v1.4.230 实验性 Native Chat 支持 Antigravity，可选择 Agent 并在聊天内安装 {#v1-4-230}

2026年10月19日 发布 · [官方原文](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.230)

### 简要说明 {#v1-4-230-short}

- **实验性 Native Chat：** 在聊天中使用 Antigravity，选择哪些 Agent 以聊天形式打开，并在聊天内安装缺失的 Agent。将复制的文件粘贴为附件、排队图片，并在附件与队列操作进行中看到更清晰的反馈。
- **账号与 Agent：** 切换 Claude 账号后，重启正在运行的会话到新账号。从 Settings 移除已下载的 Agent 运行时，并通过 Orca CLI 编辑或删除 Linear 评论。
- **手机端：** 就地编辑队列中的消息，用桌面风格卡片跟随工具运行，从历史恢复时立即看到对话。横屏手机把会话标签放在顶栏，Tasks 清楚显示你正在使用哪个桌面。

### 兼容性与升级说明 {#v1-4-230-compatibility-upgrade-notes}

- **实验性 Native Chat：** Antigravity 与聊天内安装需要更新过的宿主。请与 Orca 一起更新已配对与 SSH 宿主。

---

## v1.4.229 实验性 Native Chat 可逐轮审查编辑，共享技能支持更多 Agent {#v1-4-229}

2026年10月17日 发布 · [官方原文](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.229)

感谢使用 Orca，也感谢一直以来的支持。

### 简要说明 {#v1-4-229-short}

- **实验性 Native Chat：** 可在对话内逐轮审查编辑、展开图表平移缩放、一键分享聊天视觉内容，并查看 Claude 目标与 Codex 上下文用量。键盘回答、未读分隔线与选中复制让长对话更易浏览。
- **共享技能：** 共享技能安装现支持额外 20 个 Agent，WSL 发现范围更广，并为 Kiro、Qoder、CodeBuddy 等工具提供正确安装位置。
- **手机端：** 工作区筛选、分组与排序跟随桌面共享选择。长按查看关联问题与笔记，可操作服务器工作区与浏览器页面，或在新终端对话中继续支持的聊天。
- **SSH 与远程终端：** 重连修复保留分屏、粘贴顺序与托管服务器项目分组。休眠 Agent 会恢复其对话，移除一台机器的项目不会影响同路径的另一台。
- **工作区与日常打磨：** 用 Cmd/Ctrl+J 打开网站，创建 worktree 时观看检出进度，清理工作区前有明确确认再停止正在运行的 Agent。
- **Jira 规划：** 在问题列表与看板间切换，聚焦当前冲刺，复用已保存的 JQL 与 Jira 收藏，从桌面或手机启动工作区。Agent 也可通过 Orca CLI 读取与更新 Jira 工单。

### 已知问题 {#v1-4-229-known-issues}

**实验性 Native Chat：** 依赖远程主机的功能仅在该主机支持时可用。请与 Orca 一起更新主机以获取最新能力。

**SSH 主机上的 `orca` 命令：** 现有主机保留已保存的 Orca CLI 控制偏好。要让那里的 Agent 管理工作区或控制桌面浏览器，请在 Settings → SSH Hosts → 编辑主机 → Advanced Connection 中打开 **Allow this host’s orca CLI to control Orca**。

---

#### Performance & reliability {#v1-4-229-performance-reliability}

> 减小：repeated status subscriptions and session-stream work, avoid blocking WSL checks, and make workspace creation and switching smoother.

- 发送：PTY output to main as raw bytes, not NDJSON（[@outof-place](https://github.com/outof-place)，[#27006](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27006)）

- Resolve terminal names once per full process capture（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#27146](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27146)）
- Pipeline fresh transcript discovery with bounded I/O（[@outof-place](https://github.com/outof-place)，[#27009](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27009)）
- 减小：terminal ANSI scanning work（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#27344](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27344)）
- Release startup allocations held by journal sentinel（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#27342](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27342)）
- 保留：Git scans when saving sort order（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#27343](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27343)）
- 跳过：unchanged lineage after sidebar order saves（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#27384](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27384)）
- Overlap Bun typechecking and skip redundant alias scans（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#27382](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27382)）
- Yield between bounded slices of terminal output ingest（[@Jinwoo-H](https://github.com/Jinwoo-H)，[#27578](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27578)）
- Search Windows-drive projects with host ripgrep（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#27690](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27690)）

- Check clock skew on every cell production.tfvars declares（[@zanmlakar](https://github.com/zanmlakar)，[#28786](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28786)）
- Destroy a pooled client whose session the server ended（[@Jinwoo-H](https://github.com/Jinwoo-H)，[#29573](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29573)）
- One ask-wait clamp and no needless exports（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#29835](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29835)）

## v1.4.227 Native Chat 拥有独立权限模式，会话更易继续 {#v1-4-227}

2026年10月16日 发布 · [官方原文](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.227)

感谢使用 Orca，也感谢一直以来的支持。

### 简要说明 {#v1-4-227-short}

- **Native chats have their own permission mode.** Choose permissions for each new Claude or Codex chat from Settings → Chat → Behavior; existing chats keep the mode they were already using, and changing models no longer resets it.
- **Native chat sessions are easier to continue.** You can resume large terminal conversations in a new Native Chat, recover chats whose only work ran in the background after a restart, and see every supported chat provider accurately in Session History.
- **Claude accounts and Codex chat setup are smoother.** Claude accounts again use separate folders, the sign-in link can be copied, Codex chats require version 0.136.0 or later, and Codex Ultrafast is available as a speed choice.
- **Browser automation gives your keyboard back reliably.** Agent browser commands target the intended page, and browser popups behave more like Chrome.
- **Also:** worktree cleanup is safer, read macOS notifications disappear from Notification Center, long chats load better on phones, and cold session-history reads avoid unnecessary reindexing.

---

### 产品体验 {#v1-4-227-product}

#### UI / workspace {#v1-4-227-ui-workspace}

> Safer worktree cleanup, tidier macOS notifications and small translation cleanup.

- 修复（worktrees）：never delete a folder git no longer tracks（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#25075](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25075)）
- 修复（notifications）：remove read macOS notifications from Notification Center by pane thread（[@Jinwoo-H](https://github.com/Jinwoo-H)，[#28425](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28425)）
- 修复（i18n）：drop chat-mode keys removed from en.json in #28113（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#28131](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28131)）

## v1.4.225 SSH 与托管服务器：新连接使用托管服务器，旧终端继续工作 {#v1-4-225}

2026年10月14日 发布 · [官方原文](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.225)

感谢使用 Orca，也感谢一直以来的支持。

### 简要说明 {#v1-4-225-short}

- **SSH 与托管服务器：** 新的 SSH 连接现在使用 Orca 的托管服务器。v1.4.224 留下的正在运行的终端在升级和重连后仍在其现有标签中继续工作；新终端在托管服务器上打开。已保存的端口转发恢复，Windows 托管主机终端获得 `orca` CLI，托管的 Claude 聊天在桌面断开后仍保持其提供方运行。无法运行托管服务器的主机会显示明确原因；旧的 SSH 回退不再可用。
- **Native Chat（实验性）：** 代码块和 shell 命令会高亮，附加文件显示为文件名药丸，即使 Agent 正在提问时你也可以编辑排队消息。Codex 提供 Ultrafast，并可停止后台命令和子 Agent；Grok 也可以列出并停止其后台命令。新聊天立即保存其第一条消息，已关闭的聊天保持关闭，被中断的回复会在解释卡片中放入 **Continue**。Mermaid 图在暗色模式下更好，聊天可视化可以在自己的标签中打开。
- **Agent 与账户：** Kiro 报告 Agent 状态并出现在 Session History 中。Claude 账户使用单独文件夹并提供 **Copy sign-in link instead**。编排 worker 可以为支持的 Agent 以 Native Chat 启动，Agent 启动设置在工作区自己的宿主上编辑，账户切换和 MCP 设置跟随选定的宿主。
- **远程工作：** Ports 面板在工作区自己的计算机上扫描并停止端口，Resource Manager 列出该宿主的进程，Agent Dashboard 可以从拥有宿主显示终端预览。文件、项目创建、pull request 和 merge request 操作、账户结果和设置跟随拥有它们的计算机。重新配对同一服务器会保留其环境，一条不可读的已保存记录不再使整个服务器不可用。
- **服务与更新：** `orca serve --supervise` 获得一个从应用外副本运行的监督器，`orca serve service install`、`status` 和 `uninstall` 管理服务。更新在无头重启前保留 Codex 登录，macOS 终端权限在应用更新后幸存，自动终端恢复被节拍和限制以避免失控重启。Linux 保留仍在使用的 AppImage 副本，如果终端后台服务的文件消失则显示持久重启横幅。
- **手机与 iPad：** Grok、OpenCode、OMP 和 Pi 聊天在手机上打开。iPad 保持聊天草稿和宿主侧栏可访问，工作区徽章显示 SSH 宿主健康，工具结果跟随正确的命令，终端视图在流结束后接受新快照。
- **工作区与自动化：** 你可以从 CLI 复制稳定的标签引用并管理工作区引用，并从 CLI 在现有工作区中启动 Agent。文件夹工作区作为自动化目标出现，多日计划正确显示，已移除的文件夹工作区不再留下空白侧栏行，**worktree is ready** 通知保持直到你关闭它。特性分支不再借用无关的 pull request。
- **Windows、WSL 与 Linux：** Windows 通知不再冻结 Orca，CodeBuddy hooks 无需 PowerShell 7 即可工作，在 cmd.exe 或 Git Bash 中退出 Claude 或 Codex 会从运行列表中移除它。WSL 路径在 Cursor 的 WSL 模式中打开，后台工作让已停止的发行版保持休眠，Windows 驱动器搜索使用宿主的 ripgrep，Wayland 剪贴板文本保持当前。
- **可靠性与性能：** Orca 更可靠且响应更快，具有更安全的终端恢复、更强的连接恢复、更少的主线程工作和更快的后台与 CI 工作流。
- **其他：** Nim 和 Typst 高亮不再让长行冻结窗口，HTML 预览加载授权的 Web 字体，链接像在 Chrome 中一样在 Orca 标签中打开，取消的浏览器标签拖动留下可点击的标签，终端输出、用量计数和项目发现在主线程上做更少工作。

### 已知问题 {#v1-4-225-known-issues}

**较旧 SSH 终端中的 `orca` 命令：** 从 v1.4.224 保持运行的终端仍接受输入、输出和调整大小，但那些较旧终端内 `orca` 命令不可用。在同一宿主上的新终端中运行它们（#27787）。

### 产品体验 {#v1-4-225-product}

#### Native chat (experimental) {#v1-4-225-native-chat-experimental-}

#### Serving, updates & terminal recovery {#v1-4-225-serving-updates-terminal-recovery}

## v1.4.224 自动化可按次指定模型与 effort，SSH 主机改跑托管 Orca 服务器 {#v1-4-224}

2026年10月10日 发布 · [官方原文](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.224)

感谢使用 Orca，也感谢一直以来的支持。

### 简要说明 {#v1-4-224-short}

- **自动化现在可以为每次运行指定 Agent 的模型和 effort。** 在自动化编辑器里打开 Advanced，填入 **Extra agent arguments**（或在 `orca automations create` 与 `edit` 时使用 `--extra-agent-args`），例如 `-model haiku --effort high`。目前对 Claude、Codex、Grok 和 CodeBuddy（模型和 effort）、Cursor（模型，effort 随之）和 OMP（模型）有效，更多 Agent 支持即将到来。每次运行都会开启全新会话，其他自动化仍保持宿主默认。另外，在已有工作区的 Orca 服务器上定时运行时，任务现在会交给启动后才读取它的 Agent（如 Aider、Goose 和 Amp），不再让它们空等。
- **SSH 主机现在运行托管的 Orca 服务器。** Orca 自带运行时，连接时自动设置，不再因为主机 Node 版本不对或缺少构建工具而失败。没有打开终端的主机会在下次连接时切换，并带上项目、文件夹和已打开的编辑器标签。有打开终端的主机继续按原方式工作，并提供 **Move to a managed Orca server**，会重启那些终端。无法运行的主机保持现有连接，Settings → SSH Hosts 会说明原因。你可以在 Settings → Managed servers 里查看、更新、回滚、**Recover** 或 **Forget** 每一台服务器。
- **Native Chat（实验性）：** 如果已打开 Chat UI 且默认视图是聊天，支持的 Agent 现在默认以结构化聊天打开。如果默认是 Terminal，新的 Agent 标签仍留在终端，并有一次性提示说明变化、允许打开聊天模式。你可以从标签右键菜单或 Agent Session History（**Resume in New CLI** / **Resume in New Native Chat**）在聊天和终端之间移动对话。
- **Native Chat 更多内容：** 近期版本的 OpenCode（包括 2.x）、Pi 和 OMP 在这台计算机上以结构化聊天打开。Agent 可以在回复里直接绘制图表、示意图和原型（桌面和手机均可，可在 Settings → Chat → Inline visuals 关闭）。Cmd/Ctrl+F 搜索聊天，可以用 **Add to chat** 引用回复的一部分，上下方向键回忆你发送过的每一条 prompt，数字键回答 Agent 的问题，长消息和工具调用序列折叠成一行。模型选择器不再等待 Agent 启动，Codex 和 Pi 在你发送前就会说明未登录，被 Orca 中断的回复会说明原因并提供 **Continue**。Grok 会显示其子 Agent，Grok、OpenCode 和 OMP 支持 `/compact`。
- **SSH 与远程终端：** 网络中断期间你输入的按键会按顺序精确送达一次，回滚和窗格大小在重连后仍在，打开的标签在托管服务器更新后会重新附着。打印文字的 shell 启动文件、有数万条目的文件夹和 64 位 ARM Linux 服务器不再导致连接失败或断开。当两台机器共享路径时，文件、浏览器标签、链接和拖放会留在它们所属的机器上。`orca serve` 现在会加载它的 SSH 主机，在服务机器上退出窗口不再停止服务器。
- **手机：** 在手机上打开的浏览器标签会在桌面最小化或屏保时继续加载，聊天可视化和子 Agent 会显示在手机的 Native Chat 里，视频和音乐文件可以在预览中播放。
- **工作区与编辑：** 你可以把多个 pull request、merge request 和任务附加到同一个工作区。悬停标签会显示带图标和程序的完整标题，Force Delete 可以记住 **Always force delete**，**Continue in New Session** 现在改为 **Hand Off to Another Agent**。Markdown 会显示 GitHub 风格的 callout（如 `> [!NOTE]`），PDF 可以用捏合和 Cmd/Ctrl+`=`/`-` 缩放，从 Finder 或文件资源管理器拖入的文件会精确落到你放下的窗格、文件夹或编辑器。
- **其他：** 状态栏的用量仪表现在默认使用更短的 Compact 视图（除非你已选择过，Detailed 仍可用），Stage All 即使列表上限为 1000 也会暂存所有更改，即使 `gh` 启动器卡住，Orca 也能检测到 GitHub CLI。

### 已知问题 {#v1-4-224-known-issues}

**SSH 主机上的 `orca` 命令：** 默认情况下，在 SSH 主机上运行的 `orca` 命令只能触及该主机自己的终端和编排消息。要让那里的 Agent 通过 `orca` 创建 worktree、打开终端或分发工作，请为该主机打开 **Allow this host's orca CLI to control Orca**（Settings → SSH Hosts → 编辑主机 → Advanced Connection）（#26483）。

**降级到 v1.4.223：** 在 v1.4.224 启动的终端，在你再次更新之前，v1.4.223 无法触及。附加到文件夹工作区的额外 pull request、merge request 和任务会被移除。如果 Chat UI 是打开的，再次更新后可能会关闭；请在 Settings → Experimental 里重新打开。已移动到托管服务器的 SSH 主机在 v1.4.223 里通过旧连接工作；如果你在那里添加或移除项目，更新后主机会显示 "Changed on an older Orca" 并提供 **Move the new projects**。Orca 仍拒绝从版本选择器安装早于 v1.4.214 的版本。要回到那些版本，先关掉 Orca，运行 `orca profile state rollback --latest-json`，再手动安装旧版本（#23262）。

**更新后的终端：** 这一版为新终端启动新的终端后台服务。已经打开的终端继续跑在前一个服务上，因此本版本的改动只作用于更新后打开的终端。

**来自 v1.4.217 或更早版本的 Native Chat：** 如果你在 v1.4.217 或更早版本用过实验性 Native Chat，并直接更新到 v1.4.224，更早的 Native Chat 不会出现。它们的文件仍在磁盘上（#26038）。

**从 shell 历史重新启动：** 当 Agent 的启动命令很长或跨越多行时，shell 历史里保存的是一条短的一次性命令，因此按上方向键再按 Enter 不会再次启动该 Agent（#23962）。

**从手机创建的工作区：** 在手机上从 issue、pull request 或 Linear 条目创建带 Agent 的工作区，仍会把桌面移到该工作区（#26025）。
### 产品体验 {#v1-4-224-product}

#### 自动化 {#v1-4-224-automations}

> 每个自动化可以设置自己的模型和 effort，已有工作区里由服务器运行的自动化现在会把任务交给启动后才读取它的 Agent。

- 允许自动化每次运行传递额外的 Agent 参数（[@AmethystLiang](https://github.com/AmethystLiang)，[#26659](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26659)）
- 把定时自动化的 prompt 发送给启动后才读取它的 Agent（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#26703](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26703)）

#### Native Chat（实验性） {#v1-4-224-native-chat-experimental}

> 结构化聊天成为 Chat UI 默认（Terminal 默认用户保持不变），OpenCode、Pi 和 OMP 加入结构化聊天，Agent 可以显示内联可视化，聊天获得查找、引用、prompt 回忆、更整齐的工具行、更清晰的登录和停止消息，以及更稳定的消息队列。

- 把实验性 Native Chat 默认设为结构化聊天（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#22933](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22933)）
- 保持 Chat UI 用户默认 Terminal 时仍用终端，并在升级提示中提供聊天模式开关（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#26915](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26915)）
- 为升级前已开启 Experimental Chat UI 的用户显示一次性 Native Chat 升级提示（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#26710](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26710)）
- 从标签右键菜单提供 Resume in New CLI / Native Chat（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#26705](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26705)）
- 新增（session-history）：Resume in New CLI 把 Native Chat 的对话分叉到终端（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#26336](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26336)）
- 通过 Agent Client Protocol 打开 OpenCode 结构化聊天（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#25845](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25845)）

#### Agent、集成与编排 {#v1-4-224-agents-integrations-orchestration}

> 会话交接有了更清晰的名称，DeepSeek Harness 会报告空闲，OpenCode 2 恢复时保持其启动模式，手机和 CLI 创建工作区与桌面一致，Windows Agent hooks 启动更快。

- 检测卡住的启动器背后已安装的 GitHub CLI（[@OrcaWin](https://github.com/OrcaWin)，[#25183](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25183)）
- 新增（agent-sessions）：把 "Continue in New Session" 重命名为 "Hand Off to Another Agent"（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#26375](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26375)）
- 修复（runtime）：在其 hook-store 完成时结算 DSH tui-idle（[@Jinwoo-H](https://github.com/Jinwoo-H)，[#26481](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26481)）
- 恢复会话时尊重 OpenCode 2 的启动模式（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26843](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26843)）
- 通过启动执行器启动 worktree.create 的 Agent（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#26709](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26709)）
- 通过启动执行器启动编排 worker 和远程 worker（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#26724](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26724)）
- 修复（worktrees）：手机或 CLI 创建仅在文件夹匹配时才保留稀疏预设（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#26104](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26104)）
- 修复（worktrees）：手机或 CLI 创建时像桌面一样把 Agent 放到 orca.yaml 的第一个默认标签（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#26106](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26106)）
- 修复：在安全的配置文件路径上直接分发 Muse Windows hooks（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26755](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26755)）
- 修复（hooks）：加速受保护的 Unicode Windows hook 启动（[@OrcaWin](https://github.com/OrcaWin)，[#26382](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26382)）
- 性能：安装 Agent hooks 时跳过未使用的 Grok login-shell 探测（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26241](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26241)）

#### SSH、托管服务器与远程 {#v1-4-224-ssh-managed-servers-remote}

> SSH 主机迁移到托管的 Orca 服务器，远程终端在中断期间保留输入、回滚和大小，文件、链接、浏览器标签和拖放留在它们所属的机器上。

- Phase 3：每台 SSH 主机运行托管的 Orca 服务器（orcad），替换中继，且 orca serve 在其上运行（[@OrcaWin](https://github.com/OrcaWin)，[#24863](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24863)）
- Phase 3.5：从根因修复顶级 SSH/远程问题（[@OrcaWin](https://github.com/OrcaWin)，[#26483](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26483)）
- Phase 3.7：修复对抗性真实主机测试发现的 SSH/远程失败（[@OrcaWin](https://github.com/OrcaWin)，[#26847](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26847)）
- 修复（remote-terminal）：在重试中保持断开输入宽限期的诚实（[@OrcaWin](https://github.com/OrcaWin)，[#26871](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26871)）
- 在托管的 Linux 和 macOS 服务器上提供 Orca CLI（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26539](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26539)）
- 保持托管服务器在应答前不可验证（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26637](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26637)）
- 避免声称不可验证的托管服务器已停止（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26663](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26663)）
- 通过当前 SSH 连接重新连接托管服务器（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26645](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26645)）
- 手动更新托管服务器后刷新 SSH 状态（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26665](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26665)）
- 在 Settings 中解释 Active Server 停止拒绝（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26584](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26584)）
- 保持打开的 Remote Settings 与已保存服务器同步（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26581](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26581)）
- 当 SSH 主机移动到 Remote 时重试失败的目录读取（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26531](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26531)）
- 保持已迁移的文件夹工作区在其 Remote 宿主下（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26535](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26535)）
- 保持远程文件夹侧栏行在不同执行宿主间区分（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26634](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26634)）
- 保持 Git 身份探测不阻止 SSH 主机重新转换（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26578](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26578)）
- 从已安装的提供方报告浏览器放置支持（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26559](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26559)）
- 托管转换后保持新浏览器标签在 SSH 路由上（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26570](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26570)）
- SSH 转换期间保留已保留的桌面浏览器页面（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26572](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26572)）
- 区分远程浏览器失败与服务器连接失败（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26573](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26573)）
- 列出远程 Markdown 前等待编辑器所有权（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26590](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26590)）

- 远程宿主联系恢复时恢复编辑器文件监视（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26606](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26606)）

- 避免恢复期间重复历史序列化（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26160](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26160)）
- 性能：避免在已保存检查点之间复制 Codex 输出（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26199](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26199)）
- 释放已完成的提供方写入负载（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26208](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26208)）
- 主循环停滞故障前排空排队的 SQLite 回复（[@nwparker](https://github.com/nwparker)，[#26444](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26444)）

## v1.4.223 实验性 Native Chat 可回退对话，SSH 重连后保留标签 {#v1-4-223}

2026年10月8日 发布 · [官方原文](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.223)

感谢使用 Orca，也感谢一直以来的支持。

Orca Server 2.0 即将推出，会让远程工作更可靠。当前 Remote Server 仍是实验功能，可能有 bug。

### 简要说明 {#v1-4-223-short}

- **实验性 Native Chat：** 在设置 → Chat UI 打开「Use updated structured native chat」后，Grok 在这台计算机和已配对的 Orca 服务器上会以结构化聊天打开；SSH 和 WSL 仍用终端聊天。你可以把对话回退到更早的消息、搜索模型列表、输入 `@` 挑选工作区文件，并在新的设置 → Chat 页调整文字大小、代码大小、宽度和对比度，或匹配终端。聊天按第一条消息命名，停下来请求批准时会提醒你，未发送的草稿在重新加载或退出后仍在，并使用设置 → Agents 里保存的 Command 和 Arguments。使用 API key 的用户现在可以打开 Claude 聊天，Windows 聊天也不再拒绝启动。
- **SSH 工作区：** 打开的文件、正在运行的 Agent 标签，以及暂停的 Claude 或 Codex 恢复提议，在 SSH 重连和重启后仍在。很久以前关掉的标签不再以空壳回来。点击一个最后那个标签已被关掉的 SSH worktree，会再次打开终端。
- **远程服务器与手机：** 宿主应用重新启动后，已配对终端再次接受输入。网络中断后远程浏览器标签会回来。`orca serve` 重启后，手机仍保留每一个终端。从手机启动 Agent 会立刻显示它的标签，也不再挪动桌面窗口。在远程宿主上创建工作区，不再把其他已连接的桌面拉过去。
- **Agent 与终端：** macOS 和 Linux 上很长或多行的 Agent 启动命令会完整到达 Agent，而不是被截断或逐行执行。启动命令现在使用真正的 Enter。退出前刚关掉的窗格不再回来，拖进自己标签的窗格不再出现在两个标签里。用 Escape 取消时 Claude 的转圈会清掉；Escape 只关掉搜索时，Codex 仍保持正在工作的状态。Orca 不再在每次启动 Codex 时重写 `~/.codex` 的 hook。它为 Claude、Codex 和 OpenCode 启动的辅助进程会在 Orca 退出或崩溃时停掉。
- **账户与 Agent：** 切换 Claude 账户会保留 MCP 服务器登录。Pi 和 OMP 把后台辅助项显示为行。Rovo Dev 通过 `acli` 检测。模型列表里有 Grok 4.7。
- **侧栏与工作区：** Orca 会记住左侧栏是否打开。Agent 活动视图有过滤器、右键菜单和多选。包含嵌套 worktree 的工作区可以连它们一起在后台删除。显示远程工作区不再展开本地分区。访问该工作区时 Dock 角标会清掉。
- **文件与搜索：** 音频和视频文件可以在 Orca 里播放。Quarto 和 R Markdown 文件会高亮。你可以在 Finder 或文件资源管理器里显示源码管理中已改动的文件，或终端里的文件路径。Quick Open 能匹配多段查询，并在请求的位置打开文件。已放弃的搜索会停掉。
- **任务与审查：** GitHub Projects 的 Board 视图显示为可以拖动卡片的看板。任务描述里的私有 Linear 图片能加载。SSH 工作区里的 GitLab 合并请求和 issue 操作会到达正确的服务器。
- **其他：** 一个 Agent 紧接在另一个之后完成时，完成音现在也会播放。截图标注有了橡皮擦。
### 已知问题 {#v1-4-223-known-issues}

**来自 v1.4.217 或更早版本的 Native Chat：** 如果在 v1.4.217 或更早版本用过实验性 Native Chat，并直接更新到 v1.4.223，更早的 Native Chat 不会出现。它们的文件仍在磁盘上（#26038）。

**更新后的终端：** 这一版为新终端启动新的终端后台服务。已经打开的终端继续跑在前一个服务上，因此「完整的长启动命令」这类改动只作用于更新后打开的终端。这也意味着 v1.4.222 对 OpenCode、Pi 和 Qoder 检测的改进，在新终端里无需再重启任何东西即可生效。

**从 shell 历史重新启动：** 当 Agent 的启动命令很长或跨越多行时，shell 历史里保存的是一条短的一次性命令，因此按上方向键再按 Enter 不会再次启动该 Agent（#23962）。

**从手机创建的工作区：** 在手机上从 issue、pull request 或 Linear 条目创建带 Agent 的工作区，仍会把桌面移到该工作区（#26025）。

**降级：** Orca 现在拒绝从版本选择器安装早于 v1.4.214 的版本。要回到那些版本，先关掉 Orca，运行 `orca profile state rollback --latest-json`，再手动安装旧版本（#23262）。

**Windows on ARM：** ARM64 包装的是 x64 的 `orca.exe` 命令行工具。Windows 11 on ARM 会用模拟运行它。Windows 10 on ARM 跑不了，所以那里的 `orca` 命令不可用（#24094）。

**OpenCode 2：** 如果从 v1.4.219 或更早版本更新，已经在跑的 OpenCode 2 窗格可能要在里面重启 OpenCode 之后才有状态。这次更新之后如果降级 Orca，会留下重复的 OpenCode 状态插件。`opencode run` 退出后，窗格可能一直显示「Done」；修复还在 #24472 中等待。

**Claude 文件夹信任：** 文件夹预信任默认开启（设置 → Agents → 「Trust the folder when Orca starts an agent」）。在 Alpine WSL 上，Orca 无法复制它需要的文件权限，因此 Claude 会显示自己的信任提示（#23744）。

### 产品体验 {#v1-4-223-product}

#### 实验性 Native Chat {#v1-4-223-native-chat-experimental-}

> Grok 可以作为结构化聊天运行。你可以回退对话、搜索模型、用 @ 提及文件并调整聊天外观。聊天会有名称和批准提醒，草稿和 Stop 会留住你的文字。Codex、使用 API key 的 Claude 用户、Windows 和自定义 Agent 命令的聊天启动也更可靠。

- 修复（native-chat）：推理行有真正的展开/完成状态，Claude 的思考内容可读（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#19221](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19221)）
- 可从结构化聊天消息确认后回退一段对话（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#19338](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19338)）
- 新增（native-chat）：Grok 经 Agent Client Protocol 作为结构化聊天运行（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#25225](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25225)）
- 新增（native-chat）：恢复失败后仍记录新会话（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#25747](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25747)）
- 新增（native-chat）：可搜索的模型选择器（[@AmoabaKelvin](https://github.com/AmoabaKelvin)，[#26011](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26011)）
- 新增（native-chat）：输入 @ 时建议文件，并给这些触发器命名（[@AmoabaKelvin](https://github.com/AmoabaKelvin)，[#26017](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26017)）
- 增加聊天外观设置：文字大小、代码大小、宽度（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#25657](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25657)）

- 修复（native-chat）：代码块可以长到完整高度（[@AmoabaKelvin](https://github.com/AmoabaKelvin)，[#26021](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26021)）

- 修复（native-chat）：排队消息一直等到前面的一轮打开（Stop 事件方案的后续，修复 STA-9348）（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#25217](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25217)）
- 修复（native-chat）：Codex 接受的 Stop 会结算那条从未打开轮次的消息（#25217 的后续）（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#26105](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26105)）

- 修复（native-chat）：退出或崩溃前已接受的消息保留为一张暂扣卡片（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#24660](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24660)）
- 修复（native-chat）：Agent 退出会结束它的记录；未确认的停止改为并入，而不是暂扣（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#24862](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24862)）
- 你停掉的工具调用显示为已中断，而不是失败（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#25181](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25181)）
- 修复（native-chat）：长回复在重新加载后仍保留 Working 条和 Stop，状态来自宿主上的那一轮（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#25751](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25751)）
- 修复（native-chat）：回答落地前，prompt 卡片占住聊天输入（终端支撑的聊天，桌面和手机）（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#25761](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25761)）
- 修复（native-chat）：发送后把最新内容带进视野，并跟随回复（[@AmoabaKelvin](https://github.com/AmoabaKelvin)，[#24514](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24514)）
- 修复（native-chat）：回到聊天时丢掉它隐藏期间已经完成的后台任务（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#24305](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24305)）
- 修复（native-chat）：流中断时不再闪一下正在重连（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#24898](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24898)）
- 修复（native-chat）：启动失败的聊天在标签和工作区行上标出（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#24904](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24904)）
- 修复（native-chat）：每种聊天结果只说一次，并去掉仅内部使用的表面（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#24595](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24595)）
- 修复（native-chat）：改掉承诺会重试、会更新或即将变化的聊天文案（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#25157](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25157)）
- 新增（native-chat）：消息框上方用一张通知卡片显示聊天自己的错误（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#25835](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25835)）
- 修复（native-chat）：说明 Claude 重试进行到第几次，以及上次失败的原因（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#25818](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25818)）
- 修复（native-chat）：已发送的图片在 Agent 工作时不再闪成「Pasted image」占位（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#25664](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25664)）
- 新增（native-chat）：一次选择器选择可以附上多个文件（[@AmoabaKelvin](https://github.com/AmoabaKelvin)，[#23956](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23956)）
- 新增（native-chat）：可从右键菜单复制聊天图片（[@AmoabaKelvin](https://github.com/AmoabaKelvin)，[#24161](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24161)）
- 新增（native-chat）：在 OpenClaude 和 OMP 的聊天视图里回答 /context（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#22294](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22294)）
- 新增（floating-workspace）：浮动面板走共用的工作区表面渲染（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#22302](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22302)）
- 修复（native-chat）：启动 Codex 聊天时不再等待后台模型探测（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#23831](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23831)）
- Codex 自己的模型列表失败后仍可创建 Codex 聊天（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#25754](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25754)）
- 修复（claude）：用已保存的选项启动 Claude 聊天，并立刻发送第一条消息（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#25152](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25152)）
- 修复（claude）：使用 API key 的 Claude 用户不再被告知未登录（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#25163](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25163)）
- 修复（native-chat）：启动 Windows 聊天时不再读取进程创建时间（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#25718](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25718)）
- 修复（native-chat）：启动 Native Chat 时忽略终端启动命令（[@brennanb2025](https://github.com/brennanb2025)，[#25720](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25720)）
